# pvs (pvs.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/storage/index.html.md>

- **SnapshotService**: Snapshots: point-in-time copies of a volume, in the volume's zone.
- **StorageClassService**: The catalog of storage classes: every tier the platform publishes, each saying whether it can be selected right now.
- **VolumeService**: Block storage volumes: durable disks in one zone that an instance attaches to read and write.

## Ask before

These delete something or can't be undone: show the user what will change and wait for their yes.

- `origincloud_pvs_snapshot` destroyed or replaced: deletes for good.
- `origincloud_pvs_volume`, changing `size_gib`: A volume never shrinks back, and its larger size is charged.
- `origincloud_pvs_volume` destroyed or replaced: deletes for good.

## Types

### Snapshot

A point-in-time copy of a volume.

- resource `origincloud_pvs_snapshot`
- data source `origincloud_pvs_snapshots`: every one under a parent
- import by `name`:

  ```hcl
  import {
    to = origincloud_pvs_snapshot.this
    id = "projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/snapshots/{snapshot}"
  }
  ```

Arguments and attributes of `origincloud_pvs_snapshot`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `creator` | computed | The principal that took the snapshot, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `id` | computed | The snapshot's resource name, the same as `name`. |
| `name` | computed | The snapshot's resource name. |
| `project` | required, replaces | The project the snapshot is in. |
| `protected` | optional, computed | Whether the snapshot is protected: only a protected snapshot is the source of volumes and images, and it can't be deleted. |
| `protection_reason` | computed | Why the last protection change failed, when `protection_state` is `PROTECTION_FAILED`. |
| `protection_state` | computed | Whether it is protected. |
| `source_size_gib` | computed | The source volume's size in GiB when it was copied: the least a volume created from the snapshot holds. |
| `source_volume` | required, replaces | The volume copied, in the same project and zone. |
| `state` | computed | Where the copy is. |
| `state_reason` | computed | Why the snapshot is in `ERROR`; empty otherwise. |
| `tags` | optional | Labels of your own, at most 50. |
| `urn` | computed | The snapshot's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `zone` | required, replaces | The zone the snapshot is in. |

### StorageClass

A storage tier a volume is created in.

- data source `origincloud_pvs_storage_class`: one by its name
- data source `origincloud_pvs_storage_classes`: every one under a parent

Attributes of `origincloud_pvs_storage_class`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `available` | computed | Whether the class can be selected right now. |
| `baseline_iops` | computed | The I/O operations per second a volume of the class is limited to; 0 for a class not on sale. |
| `baseline_throughput_mibps` | computed | The MiB per second a volume of the class is limited to; 0 for a class not on sale. |
| `default_class` | computed | Whether a volume created without a storage class is created in this one. |
| `display_name` | computed | The name the console shows. |
| `media` | computed | The media the class is backed by. |
| `name` | required | The class's resource name, `storageClasses/gp1`. |

### Volume

A block storage volume in one zone.

- resource `origincloud_pvs_volume`
- data source `origincloud_pvs_volumes`: every one under a parent
- import by `name`:

  ```hcl
  import {
    to = origincloud_pvs_volume.this
    id = "projects/{project}/zones/{zone}/volumes/{volume}"
  }
  ```

Arguments and attributes of `origincloud_pvs_volume`:

| Name | Mode | About |
|---|---|---|
| `attachment` | computed | When `state` is `IN_USE`, the id of the volume attachment holding it. |
| `creator` | computed | The principal that created the volume, such as `user:<id>` or `service_account:<id>`. |
| `id` | computed | The volume's resource name, the same as `name`. |
| `iops` | computed | The most I/O operations per second the volume serves, reads and writes combined: a ceiling, not a guaranteed rate. |
| `name` | computed | The volume's resource name. |
| `pending_size_gib` | computed | The size a resize under way is heading for; 0 when none is. |
| `project` | required, replaces | The project the volume is in. |
| `resize_reason` | computed | Why the last resize failed, when `resize_state` is `RESIZE_FAILED`. |
| `resize_state` | computed | Where the last resize is. |
| `retention_note` | computed | Why the volume is still here after the instance it was created with was terminated; empty in every other case. |
| `size_gib` | required | The size in GiB, at least 1. |
| `source_snapshot` | optional, computed, replaces | The snapshot the volume was created from, in the same project and zone; empty for an empty volume. |
| `state` | computed | Where the volume is in its lifecycle. |
| `state_reason` | computed | Why the volume is in `ERROR`; empty otherwise. |
| `storage_class` | optional, computed, replaces | The storage class, `storageClasses/{storage_class}`. |
| `tags` | optional | Labels of your own, at most 50. |
| `throughput_mibps` | computed | The most MiB per second the volume transfers, reads and writes combined: a ceiling, not a guaranteed rate. |
| `urn` | computed | The volume's URN, the identifier access policies and the audit log use. |
| `zone` | required, replaces | The zone the volume is in. |

## Other actions

These methods aren't a resource's create, read, update or delete. Where an argument of a resource above sets the same thing (a resource's `protected`, say), change the argument; otherwise the provider doesn't manage the action: run it with the CLI, outside of Terraform, when the user asks for it.

- `ProtectSnapshot` (`origin pvs protect-snapshot`): Protects a snapshot, so it can be the source of volumes and images and can't be deleted.
- `UnprotectSnapshot` (`origin pvs unprotect-snapshot`): Unprotects a snapshot, so it can be deleted.
- `ImportVolume` (`origin pvs import-volume`): Creates a volume whose initial content is a disk image the platform downloads.
